newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 10.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 10.

text.p: All Mexican ports were reported open as storms in the Gulf of Mexico relaxed on Thursday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.

All of Mexico's crude ports were operating after two reopened on Wednesday following brief closures. Pajaritos in Veracruz state reopened after a six-hour closure at 1700 local/2200 GMT, while Dos Bocas in Tabasco state reopened after almost ten hours at 2200 local/0300 GMT.
Coatzacoalcos port, home to Pajaritos, was shut to smaller tourism and fishing ships. Smaller ships were warned of high winds and waves along the Pacific coasts of Baja California and Sonora states.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
